prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Moving sign-in after pet adoption (+16.8% vs +12.0%) and adding cloud storage backup copy (+4.9% vs +0.5%) were helpful and exceeded predictions, while sign-in hints, progress trackers, safeguards, and other reorders showed no clear effect.
Dynamic waiting screen additions (live progress visualizer, audio-visual ambiance) were helpful, with visualizers far exceeding predictions (+9.3% vs +2.0%), while static estimates, checklists, audio selectors, and mascot updates showed no clear effect.
Photo quality sound tips were helpful and exceeded predictions (+8.7% vs +2.0%), whereas adoption certificate redesigns severely hurt performance (-27.5%) and card layout or sound preview changes showed no clear effect.
Desktop mascot audio welcome redesign on the finish screen was helpful (+7.5% vs -3.0%), but control guides, prompts, soundboard redesigns, and incentives showed no clear effect.
All welcome path selection changes (copy, layout, and direct selection cards) showed no clear effect, with predictions consistently overestimating impact.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: +6.7% over 2 test(s)
- adoption, layout: +2.4% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -8.9% over 3 test(s)

- finish, incentive: -4.4% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: -6.6% over 1 test(s)
- finish, notification: -5.4% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +6.0% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.1% over 7 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +4.9% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +0.5% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: -1.3% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +5.1% over 3 test(s)

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pet Adoption Pick Friend Grid Redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen into a stage layout featuring animated friend previews. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 63.8%. Upgrading the visual stage improves pet choice engagement.)
1: [adoption, wait_info] Photo Upload Processing Quality Visualizer: Display a dynamic photo clarity progress indicator and status hint on the photo upload screen during image processing. (why: 3 support messages cited custom pet generation failures or unexpected pet visuals.)
2: [home, new_screen] Waiting Screen Audio-Visual Activity Stage: Insert an interactive waiting activity screen before desktop launch featuring companion audio ambiance and status updates. (why: The waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s. Interactive waiting stages reduce drop-off during render delays.)
3: [finish, copy] Desktop Mascot Control Headline Update: Update the home intro headline and body to explain basic desktop interactions such as talking, hiding, and right-clicking. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.)
4: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Voice and Sound Preview Screen: Add a dedicated pet sound selection screen right after picking a friend so users can preview voice styles. (why: Audio features showed significant positive impact (+8.7% and +7.5% in past tests). A dedicated sound preview enhances attachment during adoption.)
5: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Split Highlight Redesign: Redesign the onboarding story screen into a split layout showcasing companion traits and desktop pet benefits. (why: Choose path step has a high mean time of 514s, indicating high engagement with early story content.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Launch Ready Notification Toggle: Enable ready notifications on the waiting screen to alert users when pet desktop rendering completes. (why: Home waiting mean time is 2336s, and 3 support emails reported pets failing to appear on the desktop.)
7: [sign_in, redesign] Sign-In Screen Card Spotlight Redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen into a spotlight layout emphasizing cloud backup safety and seamless account creation. (why: 8 support tickets cited account sign-in confusion and pet loss, while sign-in accounts for 14.8% drop-off.)
8: [finish, new_flow] Finish Screen Companion Quick Controls Flow: Add an interactive desktop interaction checklist component to the home intro screen. (why: 3 emails cited post-onboarding confusion regarding pet controls and 4 emails reported desktop feature misbehavior.)
